hero.headline: Caring for the animals you love
hero.sub: Forpets Veterinary Clinic provides compassionate, expert care for your pets. From routine checkups to specialist consultations — we're here for every chapter of their life.

services.title:
Comprehensive care
under one roof
services.desc: Every service at Forpets is designed around your pet's comfort and your peace of mind.

general.name: General Checkup
general.desc: Routine wellness exams, health screenings, dental checks, and preventative care plans tailored to your pet's age and breed.

vaccine.name: Vaccine Appointments
vaccine.desc: Core and lifestyle vaccinations for dogs and cats, including rabies, distemper, bordetella, and feline leukemia. Records kept in your pet portal.

surgery.name: Surgery Consultation
surgery.desc: Pre-surgical assessments, second opinions, and elective procedure planning. Our senior veterinarians walk you through every step of the process.

diagnostics.name: Diagnostics & Lab
diagnostics.desc: On-site blood panels, urinalysis, X-ray imaging, and ultrasound. Most results returned same-day for your peace of mind.

dental.name: Dental Care
dental.desc: Professional teeth cleaning, extractions, and oral health assessments. Poor dental health affects your pet's overall wellbeing — we take it seriously.

emergency.name: Emergency — Phone Only
emergency.desc: For urgent after-hours emergencies, call us directly. We maintain an on-call line for registered patients of the clinic.

hours.title: Clinic Hours
hours.emergency: Emergencies after hours? Call our on-call line. Walk-in emergencies cannot be accommodated — please phone ahead so we can prepare.
